name: The Mall Explodes!
source:
A visual novel about a security guard with only a few minutes to stop a bomb from exploding in a shopping mall. Figure out who the bomber is and stop them before it's too late!

As a mall security guard you're used to long boring shifts punctuated by short bursts of excitement. Breaking up fights, catching shoplifters, dealing with irate customers... you thought these incidents were as exciting as mall security could get.

That is until you get a call from a FBI agent telling you that you only have ten minutes to find a bomb in the mall before it explodes.

Will you pull the fire alarm and try to evacuate everyone or will you gamble with everyone's lives and try to find the bomber? With only your fellow security guard, Madison, for backup, you find yourself with the impossible task of identifying the bomber in a shopping mall full of people before time runs out. Can you find the bomb before the mall explodes?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457830/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述一名保安仅用几分钟阻止购物中心炸弹爆炸的故事。找出炸弹袭击者是谁并在为时已晚之前阻止他们！

作为一名商场保安，你习惯于长时间无聊的轮班，中间夹杂着短暂的兴奋。制止打架、抓捕小偷、应对愤怒的顾客……你认为这些事件是商场保安最令人兴奋的事情。

直到你接到联邦调查局特工的电话，告诉你你只有十分钟的时间在商场里找到一枚炸弹，然后炸弹就会爆炸。

你会拉响火警警报并尝试疏散所有人，还是会拿每个人的生命做赌注并尝试找到炸弹袭击者？只有你的保安同事麦迪逊作为后援，你发现自己面临着一项不可能完成的任务，即在时间耗尽之前在挤满人的购物中心里识别炸弹袭击者。你能在商场爆炸前找到炸弹吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457830/]Steam[/url]]
